description: README's yield: false worst tick gap says 867 ms, recent demo runs show 500-570 ms. Several commits (defk-5s3, defk-j3h, defk-jp3, defk-7q5, defk-jaj) changed numbers measured on loaded machines. Re-run demo.exs, bench/*.exs and examples/run_all.exs on a quiet machine and update every number in README.md and examples/README.md. Record load average with the run.

comments.text: Done in the defk-sgw.4 quiet-machine session (2026-10-13, commit 3bf0bec, otherwise idle M4 Pro, load 3.1-3.3): bench/demo.exs, tick_gap.exs and yield_cost.exs rerun; docs/project.md results snapshot and README 'Where defk helps / where Elixir is the right choice' rewritten from the catalog snapshot in docs/verdict.md. The yield: false worst gap is now 554 ms (was 867 in the table). Not done here: rewriting every number in the examples/README.md table; that table becomes generated from the snapshot under defk-9p6.31.

title: Refresh README results table and demo numbers on a quiet machine
